Synopsis:
    European equities posted a modest Friday bounce but headed for their worst weekly loss in roughly two months. The selloff is driven by a toxic mix: ECB rate hikes paired with an inflation warning, oil above $100/bbl fuelled by escalating U.S.-Iran military confrontation in the Middle East, and surging sovereign bond yields globally. Markets are bracing for U.S. CPI data that could cement another Fed rate hike (67% probability priced in). The German 10-year Bund yield sits near multi-decade highs. Individual movers include Technoprobe (+3.6%) on TSMC strength and FlatexDEGIRO (-4.9%) on a chairman resignation.
